notes: M20 Barkhide Troll, printed: '{1}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature: This creature gains hexproof until end of turn.' In response to an opponent's Shock aimed at the Troll, the activation resolves first: the Troll has hexproof, so the Shock's target is no longer legal (it did target the Troll while it could) and the spell does nothing: no damage anywhere. The counter was removed when the ability was activated, so the Troll is 2/2.
